name: travel-agent-mcp-server
description: Transform your LLM into a professional AI travel agent with comprehensive tools for flight searches, hotel bookings, activity recommendations, itinerary creation, and booking assistance.
author: Travel Agent MCP

GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.description: Google Maps API key for location search and directions

AMADEUS_API_KEY.description: Amadeus API key for flight searches

AMADEUS_API_SECRET.description: Amadeus API secret for flight searches

RAPIDAPI_KEY.description: RapidAPI key for hotel and activity searches

OPENWEATHER_API_KEY.description: OpenWeatherMap API key for weather information

prompts.name: travel_agent_mode
prompts.description: Activate Travel Agent Mode - transforms the LLM into a professional travel consultant

tools.name: search_location
tools.description: Search for locations, destinations, and attractions with coordinates and addresses

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Get directions and routes between two locations

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search for hotels with pricing, ratings, and amenities

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search for flights with schedules, pricing, and booking links

tools.name: find_activities
tools.description: Discover activities, tours, and things to do at destinations

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Generate booking URLs and instructions for travel items

tools.name: get_travel_tips
tools.description: Get visa, weather, currency, and cultural information

tools.name: calculate_trip_budget
tools.description: Calculate estimated trip budgets by category
